body: T13 SPEC GAP RETROSPECTIVE. CASE 1: Score animation spec (filed 20260222-1016). Gap: no reduced-motion spec. GA had to decide independently. Correct answer: @media prefers-reduced-motion skip transition. How to prevent: T12 rule - every animation spec must have a reduced-motion section. CASE 2: SVG chart spec to GA (filed 20260222-0810). Gap: aria-label said N tests but not score values. GA implemented the spec. Screen reader says how many tests but not what the scores were. How to prevent: WCAG check is part of every spec now. For every output element ask what does a screen reader say and is that sufficient. CASE 3: Score animation spec (20260222-1016) - duration was 500ms. T11 respec changed it to 600ms based on ADHD timing research. Gap: original spec did not cite the timing rationale. If GA questioned it there was no justification. How to prevent: every duration must cite its rationale (ADHD threshold, user research, animation principle). PATTERN: my spec gaps cluster around: reduced-motion, accessibility annotation, and timing rationale. Adding these three to my spec checklist going forward.
